Frequently asked questions

Is Montanara safe?

Wandroz currently rates Montanara in Parma as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Parma during the day and relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Parma at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Parma publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Montanara safe at night?

At night, Montanara is rated as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Parma. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Montanara a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Montanara's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Parma) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
